data.caseSnapshot: The Client is an individual presenting for individual psychotherapy presenting with symptoms consistent with F41.0 Panic Disorder. During the 50-minute session utilizing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), the Client reported experiencing a panic attack at the grocery store involving a rapid heart rate and a fear of passing out in public, which led to leaving the store prematurely. The Client also reported sleep disturbances (sleeping approximately four hours per night, waking around 3:00 AM) and noted starting a new medication, sertraline 50 mg, prescribed by their primary care doctor approximately two weeks ago with initial mild nausea that has since resolved. Safety was assessed, and the Client denied any thoughts of self-harm or suicidal ideation.

areas.title: Panic Symptoms and Agoraphobic Avoidance
areas.goal: Reduce the frequency and intensity of panic attacks and decrease avoidance of feared situations.

objectives.text: Client will complete in-vivo exposure to a feared situation (e.g., grocery store) at least once per week, staying until anxiety levels decrease by half.
Client will practice prescribed interoceptive exposure exercises daily at home to reduce fear of somatic sensations.

interventions: Psychoeducation on the physiological mechanisms of panic and interoceptive exposure
Conducting in-session interoceptive exposure (e.g., spinning in chair) and processing physiological sensations
Behavioral experiments involving graded exposure to avoided public spaces

areas.title: Cognitive Restructuring
areas.goal: Identify and modify catastrophic thoughts related to panic sensations.

objectives.text: Client will complete thought records at least three times per week to identify automatic thoughts and associated belief ratings.
Client will re-evaluate and document lowered belief ratings for catastrophic thoughts (e.g., passing out) from peak anxiety to post-event reflection.

interventions: Introduction and utilization of CBT thought records
Guided discovery to examine evidence for and against catastrophic thoughts during panic
Reviewing and scaling cognitive shifts between peak anxiety and post-event states

areas.title: Sleep Disturbance
areas.goal: Improve sleep duration and sleep continuity.

objectives.text: Client will report on sleep patterns and duration at each subsequent session.

interventions: Monitoring sleep duration and nocturnal awakening patterns
Coordinating care or discussing impact of medical management (sertraline) on sleep and somatic symptoms
